# ZSM4 4.7

Unmodified tool selected for the Utilities disk. `provenance.json` records exact
binary identity, upstream revision and redistribution basis. Original ownership
and terms are retained; this is separate from BetterCP/M original code.

`source.tar.gz` is the complete corresponding source at the pinned revision,
including the original Makefile, documentation, tests, copyright and license.
The Utilities builder supplies it alongside both disk images; retain that
source companion when redistributing the package.
